icon_upgrade_spirits:
Hand-painted semi-realistic HD isometric game art, like the best classic 2D castle city-builders:
soft painterly shading, rich natural material texture, warm late-summer light from the upper left,
soft shadow to the lower right, tallgrass prairie, lake and oak woodland palette, no outlines,
no text.
Game icon of a small pale-blue glowing wisp (invented), a single painted object, three-quarter view, centred, fills about 80% of
the square, plain flat #00FF00 background, readable at 16 pixels, no frame, no text.
A completely abstract curl of pale blue mist and light, soft S-shaped wispy silhouette, icy blue-white bright centre. Entirely faceless: no eyes, mouth, head, creature, character, person, expression, symbols or decoration. Calm muted pale-blue light, no saturated cyan. Generous empty margin.
